instrument_findings.aligned_rows: Every A1, A2, and P pair has identical base/donor semantic positions and sequence lengths. Their component patches, target/P metrics, scalar games, Shapley allocations, and interactions use aligned coordinates.
instrument_findings.misaligned_rows: C base/donor semantic endpoints differ by up to three positions. The runner copied donor component responses by absolute position and compared closure over padded tensors. Its C leakage and full donor-closure diagnostics are therefore not admissible.
instrument_findings.closure_failure: The registered pred_a remains false: donor H relative error is 0.1766 and the mixed absolute closure maximum is 121344.8. This is not repaired or reclassified after seeing outcomes.
instrument_findings.scope: The original terminal remains invalid_instrument. Only the prospectively untouched, position-aligned A1/A2/P subexperiment is retained as bounded evidence; C selectivity requires a new aligned control bank.

valid_target_P_results.ten_route_union: Target behavior/Q recovery is 0.9800/0.9812, but P behavior/Q leak is 0.1727/0.1613, so the registered P selectivity bar fails even without C.
valid_target_P_results.shapley: Eight routes have positive >=0.05 allocations on both behavior and q with stable half signs. MLP pair interactions are strongly negative (largest magnitudes around -0.16), showing redundancy; four-head pair interactions are near zero to mildly positive. Shapley efficiency residual is 4.44e-16.

claims_allowed: The fixed four-head set prospectively reproduces about 72% of fresh v22 target behavior and reader-contracted Q with high cosine and low aligned P leakage.
Each of the four v15/v21 heads independently replicates on v22 target/P rows.
Adding the six broad MLP response routes closes target recovery but violates the aligned P bar and is highly redundant by exact pair interactions.
claims_forbidden: The four-head circuit passes the complete A1/A2/P/C protocol.
The v22 C leakage numbers establish unrelated-task selectivity.
The invalid pred_a can be changed to true without a prospective audit.
A subset chosen from v22 Shapley values is already confirmed.
next_step: Construct a new capability-gated bank whose C base/donor sequences are position-compatible, then test only the already frozen four-head singleton/union program with exact self-patch, donor closure on aligned rows, reader-contracted Q, behavior, P, and C. No route selection or dose tuning is permitted.
